Messages.Author: Emiliano Imeroni
Messages.Body:
Hi all,

I was happily opening my shiny new Ebony Kingdom boosters, when
happiness turned into sadness and surprise...

I had previously opened half of a box that I shared with a friend,
finding the usual optimal distribution typical of small sets.

However, when I turned to the next box, I found out that several
boosters contained NO rares at all (either 2 commons or 1 common + 1
Aye/Orun in the 2 possible "rare slots"). I noticed that the
"unwanted" additional commons were always either Brutal Influence or
My Kin Against the World.

After opening half a box, namely 18 boosters, and finding that NINE of
them did not contain any rares, I stopped, leaving the second half of
the box unopened.

50% of the boosters in half a box without a rare?!? Was anyone else
similarly screwed?

Emiliano

Messages.Author: Powerlord
Messages.Body:
Even thou i'm not from WW, to give you a straight answer, here is my
opinion of what might have happened to you (and that also happened to
me).

I open up a box of EK boosters and i also thought it didn't have any
rares, but then, after opening all boosters, i found out the
distribution on my box was:
4 common, 3 uncommon (vampires), 1 rare, 3 common.

After i got home i check the rarity of those cards and i was right.

Probably they altered the "distribution" on the boosters. I think that
in 3rd Ed ou LotN, the rare was the first one. So it's just a question
of order.

Fell free to check the amounts of cards you have and look at their
rarity, you might find i'm right.

Ricardo Marta

Portugal

Messages.Author: librarian
Messages.Body:


As mentioned, the last card in the pack is *NOT* the rare card in this
set. It is always one of 4 cards: Brutal Influence, My Kin Against the
World, Aye, or Orun.

You will find the rare immediately after the vampires. Check it out
against the list on WW.

Now, if you received Brutal Influence in the slot right after the
vampire, then you have a legit beef.

I'd hate for retailers and WW to issue mass replacements to people when
it isn't necessary.

best -

chris
